name: ProgressivePunch
notes: Left-leaning scorecard (Progressive Punch). Its House and Senate score tables have two column groups, '2025-26 Progressive Scores' and 'Lifetime Progressive Scores', each with Overall Votes %, Crucial Votes % and a vs. State/District Tilt rank. score is the 2025-26 CRUCIAL Votes % (close votes where a small group of Democrats could swing the outcome), and lifetime is the Lifetime CRUCIAL Votes %. Overall Votes % was not stored. For first-term members lifetime equals the 2025-26 value. Collected from the two chamber tables (100 senators, 433 House rows), matched to the roster by chamber, state, district and last name; every match checked, no ambiguity. Gaps: 6 non-voting delegates and resident commissioner (Norton DC, Plaskett VI, Radewagen AS, Moylan GU, King-Hinds MP, Hernandez PR) are not in the table, so they are absent from members. Table has 433 House rows vs 439 roster House entries. All urls are the chamber table page, not member pages. Table text was read through WebFetch's summarizer and copied in 6 chunks with the row count (433) confirming no gaps; no per-row spot check against the live page beyond the first 10 rows of each chamber. The 2025-26 column reflects scores as of the fetch date (Oct 2026, updated nightly while in session).
